meta.company: Asala (agency) — building for client Best Bottles
meta.problem: Asala already authored the Best Bottles 'Family x Stone' photography direction (6 stone registers, per-family Primary/Secondary assignments, glass-color pairing rules, per-family hero prompts + prop rules). But that creative system is a static doc written for Midjourney/Flux, and the production pipeline renders on gpt-image-2 with reference-lock + real per-SKU geometry. The PDP hero lane is explicitly the un-built 'Phase 2'. The agent operationalizes Asala's direction for one family at a time into production-ready, render-ready hero specs.

agent.name: family-hero-art-director
agent.model_rationale: Newest Opus-class — judgment-heavy reconciliation (idealized creative direction vs real per-SKU hardware, brand guardrails, pipeline constraints). Quality first.
agent.system_summary: Given one Best Bottles bottle-shape family, read Asala's Family x Stone direction + the brand rules + the repo shape/applicator descriptors, and produce a production-ready Family Hero Brief: the assigned stone register applied across the family's REAL SKUs, glass-color->stone rules, PDP-uniformity rules, allowed/forbidden props, and a render-ready gpt-image-2 hero prompt grounded in real geometry and respecting reference-lock. Writes to /mnt/session/outputs/.
never_dos: Never contradict the family's assigned stone register or glass-color rules from the Asala Family x Stone map (e.g. Empire = Ochre Limestone primary; Iron Oxide is Flair-exclusive)
Never ignore a family's 'Brief Madison Studio' prop rule (e.g. Empire gold-hardware-mandatory for the prestige hero; no fresh flowers)
Never invent bottle geometry, applicator specs, or hardware not present in the attached descriptors / real SKUs
Never produce a prompt that fights reference-lock — the attached product reference is the immutable truth; the prompt restyles the scene, not the bottle
Never generate the actual image in v0 — the deliverable is the brief + render-ready prompt; pixel generation is a separate wired step

outcome.description: Produce a production-ready Family Hero Brief for the named family as hero-brief.md, ending with a render-ready gpt-image-2 hero prompt.
rubric_criteria: hero-brief.md exists, names the family, and correctly applies the family's assigned stone register from the Asala map (Empire: Primary F Ochre Limestone; Alt A Sand Ripple / B Cool Slate) with the right glass-color->stone rules

Reconciles the idealized Asala direction with the family's REAL SKUs: states how the hero stays uniform across the family's actual hardware variants (silver/black/leather/dropper), not only the cobalt+gold prestige shot
Grounded in the repo's real Empire shape + applicator descriptors and the 2080x2288 / hero canvas contract; respects reference-lock (reference = product truth, restyle scene only)

On-brand: warm-neutral + muted-gold language, carries Empire's 'gold hardware caps mandatory' and prop rules; zero forbidden elements (navy, double borders, CTA chrome, legacy taglines, off-register stones)
Specifies PDP-uniformity rules: which hero shot(s) / angles, and what makes every Empire SKU read as one coherent set on the page
Ends with a copy-paste render-ready gpt-image-2 hero prompt (incl. negatives) that a Madison operator could run against an Empire reference today

connections.notes: v0 reads attached files only; no web, no external calls. Inputs: Asala Family x Stone Mapping (PDF), Family Stone Map (PNG), Image Prompts (PDF) + repo bestBottlesBrand.ts, familyShapeDescriptors.ts, applicatorShapeDescriptors.ts, imagePresets.ts (hero preset), and an Empire catalog slice. Roadmap: wire the renderer (Supabase generate-madison-image custom tool / Higgsfield MCP / gpt-image-2 direct) to actually produce the hero.

schedule.human: Run per family (20+ families). On-demand, not scheduled.
schedule.kickoff: user.define_outcome (task + rubric), one session per family

cases.name: empire
cases.expected: Hero brief applying Ochre Limestone (primary) reconciled across Empire's real SKU hardware; verified v0 output becomes the baseline

evals.notes: Source of truth = Asala Family x Stone plan + brand rules (not greenfield). Case 1 = Empire (Primary F Ochre Limestone). Held-back families after case 1 passes: Cylinder (B Cool Slate), Flair (D Iron Oxide, exclusive) as a guardrail test, Geometric Group (A Sand Ripple).

defaults_applied.write_actions: None in v0 — deliverable is the hero brief + render-ready prompt

interface.how: Hero brief lands as a file; Console for run history. Terminal + scripts are the interface for v0.
